recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆細胞核偏於一側、細胞質深藍、核旁有淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，染色質呈車輪狀，其中有雙核漿細胞與較大、核仁可見的不成熟漿細胞，數量明顯增加，支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, including clusters, among residual granulocytic precursors
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin; some immature forms with visible nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear Golgi zone (hof)
Binucleated and occasional multinucleated plasma cells; some with irregular cytoplasmic blebs
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles; red cells in the background overlap but definite rouleaux stacks are not clearly appreciated in these crops
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a prominent increase in plasma cells, occurring singly and in small clusters. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof; binucleated forms and immature plasma cells with nucleoli are present. Residual myeloid precursors and segmented neutrophils are seen. Rouleaux, although described clinically, is not convincingly demonstrated in these cropped fields. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; quantification on a 500-cell differential, CD138 immunohistochemistry and light-chain restriction studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually <10% of marrow cells, lack binucleation/nucleoli and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than a predominant sheet of atypical plasma cells.
Osteoblasts are larger with a hof located away from the nucleus and occur in loose clusters, and are CD138-negative.
Plasmablastic cells are large with prominent nucleoli and high proliferation, often EBV-positive, with extramedullary presentation.
